title: Service-account self-serve onboarding: approval flow, owner attestation, and short-lived credentials
creator: Maya Patel
description: We need a hardened self-serve flow for creating service accounts that enforces least-privilege templates, requires owner attestation, issues short-lived credentials by default, and emits structured audit events for every lifecycle action. This ties into RBAC v2 role templates and SSO/SAML admin approvals for elevated templates. Goals: reduce blast radius of long-lived keys, ensure clear ownership, and provide auditability for compliance reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create service accounts via Console and API; creation requires selecting a least-privilege template or entering justification for a custom scope.
An owner (user or group) must be asserted on creation; owner is validated against SSO directory when possible.
Credentials issued are short-lived by default (TTL 24h) with transparent rotation options; ability to request longer TTL requires manager/admin approval.

All create/update/delete/credential-issue/rotation events appear in audit logs with structured JSON payloads and stable event names (svcacct.create, svcacct.update, svcacct.issue_cred, svcacct.rotate, svcacct.revoke).
RBAC v2 templates are selectable and enforced in the backend; mismatches are rejected with actionable errors.
Admin UI shows pending approval queue for templates requiring SSO/SAML admin approval and exposes a link to the attestation record.
Automated tests validate template enforcement, audit emission, and TTL enforcement.
Security review sign-off and a short runbook for incident response are published before release.
implementation_notes: API: Add POST /admin/service-accounts and PATCH /admin/service-accounts/{id} extensions for template_id and owner_attestation fields.
Auth: Enforce SSO group mapping when owner provided; fallback to email validation for non-SSO users.
Credentials: Integrate with KMS-backed ephemeral key manager. Default TTL 24h; support token exchange endpoints for rotation.
Audit: Emit structured events to audit pipeline (event_type, actor_id, target_id, template_id, ttl_requested, justification).
RBAC: Hook into RBAC v2 evaluator to validate requested roles against the selected template and deny on mismatch.
UI: Console flow to surface least-privilege templates, show required approvals, and display owner attestation checkbox and linked identity.
Approval workflow: For templates marked admin-only, create an approval ticket in the admin queue; approvals recorded in audit with approver identity and SSO assertion reference.
Migration: Provide a migration script to tag existing service accounts with owner metadata and flag long-lived keys for rotation.
Observability: Add dashboard for svcacct.* events, a metric for % of accounts with owner set, and alerts for aging credentials > 30d.
Privacy/compliance: Mask sensitive fields in audit streams and provide redaction rules for exported logs.
steps: Design review with Security and Product (links in attachments).
Implement API surface and RBAC v2 validation in the backend runtime layer.
Wire KMS ephemeral issuance and integrate rotation endpoints; unit tests for TTL enforcement.
Console changes: template picker, owner attestation UI, approval queue UI.
Add audit event producers and schema validation in pipeline.
End-to-end QA with SSO/SAML admin flows and escalation paths.
Run migration on a small subset of accounts and verify telemetry.
Security review and sign-off; ship behind feature flag and stage rollout.
